steps.title: Define Project Specifications
steps.description: Establish the UI layout of the Calculator Plus app, supporting basic arithmetic operators and parenthesis.

steps.title: Setup App Directory and Package Structure
steps.description: Create packages following the pattern com.calculatorplus.app.

steps.title: Create Application Metadata Config
steps.description: Include app-meta.json at root specifying package name and app name.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings in Gradle
steps.description: Configure compilation and SDK constraints compatible with Java 17, Gradle 8.5, and target SDK 34.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest
steps.description: Establish the application entry-point and launcher properties inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Build UI Layout XML
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml with formula view, result view, and key grid buttons.

steps.title: Write Native Math Engine
steps.description: Develop a pure Java expression evaluator using standard recursive descent parsing logic inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Wire Up Layout Buttons with Listeners
steps.description: Bind numeric, operations, brackets, clear, backspace, and result buttons to listeners using standard inner classes.

steps.title: Add UI Interaction Logic
steps.description: Enable dynamic screen display refreshes, syntax handling, and automatic decimal placement safeguards.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Language Compatibility
steps.description: Check source code constraints to ensure standard anonymous inner class compatibility.

steps.title: Building Calculator Plus
steps.description: Run assembly tasks with SDK build configurations to generate the debug APK.
